items.title: ISO adopts standard for managing SDG commitments
items.summary: ISO/UNDP 53001 , released Sept. 28 during ISO’s annual meeting, establishes a management system that formalizes how companies choose SDGs, set key performance indicators to track progress and make governance decisions that consider them.

items.title: 50 years ago, Amory Lovins rewired how we think about energy — and about sustainability itself
items.summary: This week marks the 50th anniversary of one of the more consequential magazine articles in the history of energy and environmental thinking — and, I’d argue, in the trajectory of what we today call corporate sustainability.

items.title: UNGA: Guterres calls to triple climate adaptation finance
items.summary: At a high-level event at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), the Secretary-General called on leaders to mobilise at least $300bn annually for developing countries.

items.title: TODAY: What does a revised ISO 14001 mean for sustainability professionals?
items.summary: On 29 September, edie is hosting a webinar in partnership with BSI to explore changes to the ISO 14001 standard addressing environmental management.

items.title: ESRS-TC and UK SRS: Preparing for a changing sustainability reporting landscape
items.summary: Recent changes to CSRD have narrowed the number of organisations needing to report.

items.title: Bio-based materials: Improving performance, assessing carbon and scaling delivery
items.summary: As businesses seek to reduce the carbon footprint of the built environment, material choices are becoming increasingly important.

items.title: ISO launches ‘world first’ standard aligned with SDGs
items.summary: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) have partnered to launch a new standard that helps businesses and governments align their activities with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

items.title: Win a free VIP pass to edie 27: Take our sustainability snapshot survey
items.summary: Sustainability professionals have the chance to win six months of access to edie’s digital Membership offering as well as a VIP pass to edie 27 in April by completing a short survey.

items.title: From smart grids to ocean resilience: What happened at NYC Climate Week
items.summary: New York Climate Week has officially concluded, with discussions spanning energy access, electrification, ocean resilience and the transition to zero-emission fuels.
